notice.title: Interim Rollout Document
notice.body: A transitional resource for the first few weeks after go-live: a working list of common floor issues and fixes drawn from real day-to-day experience, meant to help the team get up to speed quickly — not a replacement for the official AGV and RCS user manuals, which remain the authoritative reference. This site is a living document and will be updated frequently as we learn more during this rollout period.
